plugins.name: devloop
plugins.description: Spec, plan, implement, review: a test-driven development loop for AI coding agents. /spec clarifies what to build and validates the spec. /plan decides how, then runs a plan review and a checkpoint. /implement builds with TDD, then runs a code review (conformance, correctness and cleanup lenses) and a checkpoint, and re-runs the plan review when a finding shows the plan was wrong.
